  {
    "testCaseID": "POS-001",
    "title": "Validate successful LTE multi-UE attach and detach under excellent radio conditions",
    "description": "Verify that multiple UEs (at least 2) can successfully attach and detach from an LTE cell under excellent radio conditions as per 3GPP TS 23.401.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Network configured as single isolated LTE cell with all other cells powered off",
      "Multiple stationary UEs placed under excellent LTE RSRP conditions as defined in Clause 4.6",
      "Test configuration parameters recorded",
      "E2E LTE setup operational without connectivity issues"
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Start logs to capture call flow and signaling messages",
      "Power ON all multiple UEs simultaneously to trigger LTE attach procedure",
      "Wait until all UEs have successfully completed attach procedure (attach request and attach complete messages verified)",
      "Power OFF all UEs to trigger LTE detach procedure",
      "Wait until all UEs have successfully completed detach procedure (detach request and detach accept messages verified)",
      "Stop and save logs",
      "Repeat steps 2-6 for a total of 10 iterations"
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "Attach success rate = 100% for each UE across 10 iterations",
      "Detach success rate = 100% for each UE across 10 iterations",
      "Attach latency measurements recorded with Minimum, Average, Maximum values per UE",
      "Successful attach and detach verified from UE logs by confirming UE is attached to correct cell (PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN)",
      "No connectivity issues or failures during attach/detach"
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [
      "Generic logging start command",
      "Generic UE power ON command",
      "Generic UE power OFF command",
      "Generic logging stop command"
    ],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Analyze signaling logs for attach request and attach complete messages per UE",
      "Analyze signaling logs for detach request and detach accept messages per UE",
      "Check UE logs/applications for correct cell attachment",
      "Calculate attach latency from message timestamps"
    ]
  },
